lines: Hook found at 0:52, the mukhda twice and the antara, 123 BPM.
Painted 17 scenes in a warm semi-realistic style: the grass and
the daisy, the swing, her window, the dream among the stars,
the bazaar, two terraces at night, the sunset under the tree.
Animating each painting: camera moves, depth, petals, a cloud heart,
zoom-blur cuts on the downbeat. Master: 1080x1920, 30 fps.
